# Page: Homepage (https://utim.dev/)

Title: UTIM AI — Autonomous Terminal AI Agent & Creators Ecosystem
Canonical: https://utim.dev/

## Overview
UTIM AI (v2.2.1) is a next-generation, autonomous, terminal-native AI coding assistant and miniagent marketplace. Designed for developers who live in the terminal, UTIM combines multi-LLM orchestration across 66 active models, persistent ChromaDB vector memory RAG, Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool integration, safety sandboxing, and a global creators marketplace.

## Key Highlights
- **Free Tier Available**: Full-featured CLI agent with zero required subscription fees ($0.02/$0.03 per 1M tokens for free models like `cohere/north-mini-code:free`).
- **66 Active Models**: Supports Claude 3.7 / Sonnet 4.6, OpenAI GPT-5.6 / GPT-5.3 Codex, Gemini 3.5 / 3.6, DeepSeek V4 / R1, Qwen 3.8 / 3.7 Coder, KwaiPilot, Poolside Laguna, and local Ollama / LM Studio models.
- **Creators Marketplace**: Discover, publish, buy, sell, and monetize custom miniagents and CLI extensions with up to 95% revenue share to creators.
- **Model Context Protocol (MCP)**: Native stdio and SSE MCP server integration for live databases, browser automation, filesystems, and custom APIs.
- **Vector Memory RAG**: Built-in ChromaDB vector memory that retains project architectural conventions and code experience across terminal sessions.
- **Safety Sandboxing**: Dry-run previews (`/dry-run`), `/undo`, `/rewind`, and automated git safety checks.
- **Android Termux Support**: Officially tested and supported on Android Termux environments.

## Quick Installation
- **npm**: `npm install -g @emend-ai/utim`
- **pip**: `pip install utim`

# Page: Pricing & Recalculation Engine (https://utim.dev/pricing)

Title: UTIM AI Pricing — Free, Pro, Ultimate & Creator Plans
Canonical: https://utim.dev/pricing

## Subscription Tiers

### 1. Free Plan ($0 / month)
- Price: $0.00 forever
- Quota: 1,000 free requests / day for fast coding, refactoring & debugging
- Features: Full CLI Agent, standard tool calling, MCP stdio support, local Ollama integration, access to free Marketplace miniagents.

### 2. Pro Plan ($15 / month)
- Price: $15.00 / month (or $144 / year — 20% discount)
- Quota: 2,500 monthly credits + full access to premium models
- Features: Claude 3.7 / Sonnet 4.6, GPT-5.6, DeepSeek R1, Vector Memory RAG, unlimited MCP servers, priority subagent orchestration.

### 3. Ultimate Plan ($49 / month)
- Price: $49.00 / month
- Quota: 10,000 monthly credits + unthrottled priority execution
- Features: All Pro features + 5 GB workspace sharing, custom model overrides, 24/7 dedicated support, team workspace sharing.

### 4. Creator Plan (Free for Verified Creators)
- Price: Free for published creators
- Benefits: Up to 95% revenue share on direct tool sales, verified badge in Marketplace, priority listing, creator analytics dashboard.

## Credit & Quota Recalculation Engine
- **5-Hour Slot Refills**: Allowance refills every 5 hours automatically.
- **Rollover Quota Bank**: Unused tier allowance rolls over up to 300% maximum capacity.
- **Deduction Priority Cascade**: 1) Active 24H Rewards -> 2) 5-Hour Refill Slot -> 3) Rollover Bank -> 4) Top-up Credits -> 5) BYOK.
- **BYOK Overrides**: BYOK keys bypass all quota deduction engines completely.

Title: UTIM AI vs Cursor — CLI Agent Comparison

## Comparison Matrix
- **Free plan**: UTIM: ✅ Available | Cursor: ✅ Hobby — limited Agent usage
- **Terminal-first agent**: UTIM: ✅ Native CLI | Cursor: ✅ Cursor CLI
- **npm / pip distribution**: UTIM: ✅ npm / pip* | Cursor: ❌ Separate Cursor installer
- **MCP**: UTIM: ✅ Supported | Cursor: ✅ Supported
- **Specialized subagents**: UTIM: ✅ Miniagents* | Cursor: ✅ Subagents
- **Creator monetization marketplace**: UTIM: ✅ Creators can sell & earn 80%* | Cursor: ⚠️ Plugin Marketplace; different monetization model
- **Persistent experience-memory RAG**: UTIM: ✅ ChromaDB cross-session memory* | Cursor: ⚠️ Semantic codebase indexing; not equivalent
- **Agent dry-run mode**: UTIM: ✅ Preview without committing* | Cursor: ⚠️ Has sandboxing/checkpoints, but different purpose
- **Rollback**: UTIM: ✅ `/undo` + `/rewind`* | Cursor: ✅ Local Checkpoints
- **Android / Termux**: UTIM: ✅ Official support* | Cursor: ⚠️ No official Termux support documented

# Page: Features & Documentation (https://utim.dev/features)

Title: UTIM AI Features — Vector RAG, MCP, Miniagents & Safety
Canonical: https://utim.dev/features

## Core Architectural Components

### 1. Vector Memory RAG (ChromaDB)
- Automatically indexes project codebase structure, past bug fixes, architectural conventions, and code style.
- Queries semantic memory before performing edits to ensure strict architectural compliance.

### 2. Model Context Protocol (MCP)
- Native client implementation for Model Context Protocol servers.
- Connects your terminal agent to PostgreSQL, SQLite, Playwright browser automation, GitHub APIs, and custom enterprise databases.

### 3. Subagent & Miniagent Orchestration
- Spawns isolated subagents for research, refactoring, documentation, and testing.
- Supports custom miniagent scripts published by the global developer community.

# Page: Creators Marketplace (https://utim.dev/marketplace)

Title: UTIM Creators Marketplace — Monetize Miniagents & CLI Tools
Canonical: https://utim.dev/marketplace

## Overview
The UTIM Marketplace is the global app store for terminal AI tools. Developers can build custom miniagents, publish them to the global directory, and monetize them directly. Creators receive **up to 95% revenue share** on all miniagent sales and subscription unlocks.
